issues.legal_issue: A permitted increase in rent recoverable from a tenant for a local-authority tax is included in the annual rent used to determine a building’s rateable value.
material_facts: The municipality imposed an educational cess on properties within its limits.
The landlord was entitled under the rent legislation to recover an increase corresponding to the cess from its tenants and increased the tenants’ rents by that amount.
The municipal assessor proposed a higher rateable value, and the dispute concerned whether the cess-related increase formed part of the annual rent for that valuation.
issues.conclusion: The permitted increase for the educational cess had to be included with the standard rent when determining the annual rent for rateable valuation.
issues.legal_principle: Under sections 5(7), 5(10), 7, 10, 10A and 10AA of the Bombay Rents, Hotel and Lodging House Rates Act, 1947, a permitted increase is recoverable in addition to standard rent; section 7 does not prohibit its recovery. The statutory language treats such a permitted increase as part of the rent receivable by the landlord. Under section 154(1) of the Bombay Municipal Corporation Act, 1888, annual rent reasonably expected from year to year is the basis for rateable value, so the standard rent and recoverable permitted increase are included. The Court relied on The Corporation of Calcutta v. Smt. Padma Devi for the criterion of rent realizable by the landlord and on Patel Gordhandas Hargovindas v. Municipal Commissioner, Ahmedabad for the available methods of determining annual or rateable value.

rule.if: municipal_rateable_value_assessment and rent_controlled_premises and landlord_entitled_to_recover_local_tax_increase and landlord_added_tax_increase_to_rent

predicates.municipal_rateable_value_assessment: A municipality assessed or sought to assess a building’s rateable value.
predicates.rent_controlled_premises: The building was subject to rent controls that set a standard rent while allowing specified increases.
predicates.landlord_entitled_to_recover_local_tax_i: The landlord was entitled to recover from the tenant an increase corresponding to a local-authority tax on the property.
predicates.landlord_added_tax_increase_to_rent: The landlord added that tax-related increase to the rent charged to the tenant.

issues.definition: When a municipal rateable-value assessment concerns rent-controlled premises and the landlord is entitled to and adds a local-tax increase to the rent, that increase is included in the annual rent used for the assessment.
